title: Payout and Earnings Flow
purpose: Creator payout request lifecycle from earnings aggregation through balance validation, mocked off-ramp processing, negative transaction recording, and response
description: Creator initiates payout from dashboard via POST /api/v1/creator/payouts with amount. Backend aggregates sum of creator_payout from Cleared transactions (earnings), sum of Payout transactions (withdrawals), computes availableBalance = totalEarnings - totalPayouts, validates amount <= available. Then delegates to cryptoPaymentService.processPayout which calls mocked off-ramp (returns fake transferId), records negative payout transaction in DB. Annotations highlight the mocked off-ramp (no real money movement), balance race condition (no DB-level locking), and absent minimum payout threshold.

validationRules.rule: amount must be positive finite number

businessRules.rule: No minimum payout threshold — any positive amount allowed (even $0.01)
No DB-level locking — race condition allows concurrent payout over-draft
Off-ramp is fully mocked — no real money movement (processDebitCardOffRamp returns fake data)
Platform fee = 0 for payout transactions (no additional fee on withdrawal)
Payouts are final — no reversal mechanism

securityConsiderations: Race condition: No DB-level locking between balance read and payout insert — concurrent requests could over-draft
Mock off-ramp means no actual money moved — earnings balance is purely internal ledger
No minimum payout threshold — theoretically allows spam of $0.01 payouts creating excessive transactions
Payout preference stored in profiles table — no server-side validation that wallet is actually accessible
No notification to fan or platform when payout is requested
performanceConsiderations: Earnings aggregation queries full transactions table for creator_id — could be slow for high-volume creators
Two independent SUM queries on transactions table
Dashboard earnings also fetches monthly breakdown (6 separate queries)

annotations.text: Off-ramp is fully mocked — processDebitCardOffRamp returns fake transferId with no real API call
Balance race condition — no DB-level locking between availableBalance calculation and payout insert. Concurrent requests could double-spend earnings.
No minimum payout threshold — any amount from $0.01 can be requested
platform_fee = 0 for payouts (no additional fee on withdrawal)
